title: Distinguishing case-mix from context heterogeneity in prognostic regression model synthesis settings
abstract: arXiv:2608.12885v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prognostic regression models often synthesize data from multiple sites, whether within a multi-site study, across federated settings, or in individual participant data meta-analysis. Here, a site is any data source, such as a hospital, registry, trial, or study, and need not be a physical center. Analysts must then decide whether one regression model represents all sites or whether site-specific models are needed. Established measures such as coefficient-level tau^2 quantify heterogeneity but do not distinguish its source. We focus on diagnosing whether coefficient heterogeneity reflects case-mix or site-specific context effects. Case-mix heterogeneity can arise when linear regression terms approximate multivariable non-linear relationships in populations with different covariate distributions. Contextual heterogeneity arises when comparable patients require different regression relationships across sites. We do this by fitting site-sp

translated_title: 在预后回归模型合成设置中区分病例组合与情境异质性
translated_abstract: 预后回归模型通常需要综合多个站点的数据，无论是多站点研究、联邦设置，还是个体参与者数据荟萃分析。这里，站点是指任何数据源，如医院、注册中心、试验或研究，而不必是物理中心。分析人员必须决定一个回归模型是否代表所有站点，还是需要站点特定的模型。已建立的度量如系数级别的tau^2量化异质性，但不区分其来源。我们专注于诊断系数异质性是否反映病例组合或站点特定的情境效应。病例组合异质性可能在线性回归项近似具有不同协变量分布的人群中的多变量非线性关系时出现。情境异质性则发生在可比患者在不同站点需要不同回归关系时。我们通过拟合站点特定模型来实现这一点。
tldr: 本文提出了一种诊断方法，用于区分预后回归模型中的异质性来源，即病例组合（由协变量分布差异引起）与情境效应（由站点间关系差异引起），以指导模型选择。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a diagnostic approach to distinguish heterogeneity sources in prognostic regression models—case-mix (due to covariate distribution differences) versus contextual effects (due to site-specific relationship differences)—to guide model selection.
